BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Ordering

ModuleMeta.Name: Ordering Module
ModuleMeta.Description: Domain entities, value objects, services, and checkout engine for order lifecycle management. Covers order creation, checkout state machine transitions, payment/shipment state tracking, adjustment recalculation, store credit and gift card integration, digital delivery, and cart merge operations. Ported directly from Spree::Order Ruby concerns.
ModuleMeta.StandardsAlignment: DDD tactical patterns; Vertical Slice Architecture

Principle.name: Sealed Partial Entity Pattern
Principle.Description: Domain entities are sealed partial classes with one concern per partial file, matching the Ruby concern pattern.
Principle.Rationale: Ruby concerns mix in behavior across files; C# sealed partial classes provide equivalent modularity without inheritance complexity.

Principle.name: Direct Ruby Port
Principle.Description: All business logic is ported directly from ruby-sdk-1/ Spree::Order concerns and services without a TypeScript middleman.
Principle.Rationale: Ruby types drop ~40% of business logic in translation; direct port ensures full fidelity to the tested Spree codebase.

Principle.name: Immutable Checkout Steps
Principle.Description: Checkout steps are resolved via queries not mutation; Registry supports composition without subclassing.
Principle.Rationale: Prevents state machine drift; allows third-party extensions to add/reorder steps dynamically.

Category.name: Orders
Category.Description: Order aggregate root with all lifecycle concerns.

Abstraction.name: Order
Abstraction.Description: Sealed partial aggregate root for order entity. Central entity holding line items, adjustments, payment records, and checkout state.
Abstraction.Purpose: Represents a customer order through its entire lifecycle from draft to completed or canceled.
Abstraction.Contract: Invariant: Total >= 0; ItemTotal >= 0; CheckoutState progresses forward only; Items.Count >= 1 when Status != Draft
Abstraction.TopUse: Creating and managing customer shopping carts and orders.

Abstraction.name: Order.Checkout
Abstraction.Description: Checkout state machine: step resolution, guard methods (DeliveryRequired, PaymentRequired, ConfirmationRequired, AllowCancel), and lifecycle callbacks.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::Checkout concern — defines checkout flow, transition guards, and hook callbacks.

Abstraction.name: Order.AddressBook
Abstraction.Description: Address cloning and ID assignment with ownership validation.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::AddressBook concern for billing/shipping address management.

Abstraction.name: Order.CurrencyUpdater
Abstraction.Description: Homogenizes line item currencies when order currency changes.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::CurrencyUpdater concern for multi-currency cart consistency.

Abstraction.name: Order.Payments
Abstraction.Description: Payment state tracking via PaymentRecord snapshots and unprocessed payment enumeration.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::Payments concern for payment lifecycle coordination.

Abstraction.name: Order.StoreCredit
Abstraction.Description: Store credit calculation: total applied, applicable, available, and coverage checks.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::StoreCredit concern for store credit integration.

Abstraction.name: Order.Digital
Abstraction.Description: Digital order detection and digital line item queries.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::Digital concern for digital delivery logic.

Abstraction.name: Order.Webhooks
Abstraction.Description: Webhook notification stubs for order placed/canceled/resumed events.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ports Spree::Order::Webhooks concern — dispatches lifecycle webhooks from infrastructure.

Category.name: Domain Services
Category.Description: Stateless services that coordinate order business logic.

Abstraction.name: OrderUpdater
Abstraction.Description: Updates item count, totals (payment, item, shipment, adjustment), and payment/shipment state. Ports Spree::OrderUpdater.
Abstraction.Purpose: Central recalculation engine called after any order mutation.

Abstraction.name: OrderContents
Abstraction.Description: Adds/removes line items with quantity coordination. Ports Spree::OrderContents.
Abstraction.Purpose: Cart modification entry point with inventory awareness.

Abstraction.name: OrderInventory
Abstraction.Description: Synchronizes inventory units for completed orders on line item quantity changes. Ports Spree::OrderInventory.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ensures inventory unit counts match line item quantities for completed orders.

Abstraction.name: OrderMerger
Abstraction.Description: Merges guest cart into user cart with line item deduplication and quantity accumulation. Ports Spree::OrderMerger.
Abstraction.Purpose: Cart merge on user login — combines guest and authenticated carts.

Category.name: Checkout Engine
Category.Description: Composable checkout step registry and requirement evaluation.

Abstraction.name: CheckoutRegistry
Abstraction.Description: Global registry for custom checkout steps and additional requirements. Ports Spree::Checkout::Registry.
Abstraction.Purpose: Extension point for third-party checkout steps without subclassing.

Abstraction.name: CheckoutStep
Abstraction.Description: Value object for a custom checkout step with satisfied/applicable predicates and before/after ordering.
Abstraction.Purpose: Encapsulates a single custom checkout step's behavior and position.

Abstraction.name: CheckoutRequirement
Abstraction.Description: Value object for an additional requirement attached to an existing checkout step.
Abstraction.Purpose: Adds field-level validation requirements to existing steps.

Abstraction.name: CheckoutRequirements
Abstraction.Description: Aggregates default + registered requirements for an order. Ports Spree::Checkout::Requirements.
Abstraction.Purpose: Single entry point to evaluate all unmet checkout requirements.

Abstraction.name: DefaultCheckoutRequirements
Abstraction.Description: Built-in requirements for line items, email, shipping address, shipping method, and payment. Ports Spree::Checkout::DefaultRequirements.
Abstraction.Purpose: Baseline checkout validation matching the standard Spree flow.

Category.name: Adjustments
Category.Description: Adjustment calculation, state management, and adjuster hierarchy.

Abstraction.name: Adjustment
Abstraction.Description: Entity representing a single adjustment (promotion, tax, shipping) on an order or line item.
Abstraction.Purpose: Tracks monetary adjustments with eligibility and open/closed state machine.

Abstraction.name: IAdjustable
Abstraction.Description: Interface for entities that can have adjustments (Order, LineItem).
Abstraction.Purpose: Polymorphic adjustment target for the AdjustmentsUpdater.

Abstraction.name: AdjusterBase
Abstraction.Description: Abstract base for adjustment calculators. Ports Spree::Adjustable::Adjuster::Base.
Abstraction.Purpose: Template method pattern for adjustment recalculation strategies.

Abstraction.name: PromotionAdjuster
Abstraction.Description: Selects the best competing promotion and marks all others ineligible. Ports Spree::Adjustable::Adjuster::Promotion.
Abstraction.Purpose: Ensures only the most valuable promotion applies to an order.

Abstraction.name: TaxAdjuster
Abstraction.Description: Separates included and additional tax totals. Ports Spree::Adjustable::Adjuster::Tax.
Abstraction.Purpose: Tax breakdown for pricing display and analytics.

Abstraction.name: AdjustmentsUpdater
Abstraction.Description: Orchestrates non-tax and tax adjusters, then persists totals. Ports Spree::Adjustable::AdjustmentsUpdater.
Abstraction.Purpose: Top-level adjustment recalculation coordinator.

Category.name: Supporting Entities
Category.Description: Related entities for line items, digital links, and order-promotion associations.

Abstraction.name: LineItem
Abstraction.Description: Order line item with quantity, pricing, tax breakdown, and digital flags.
Abstraction.Purpose: Represents a single product variant line within an order.

Abstraction.name: DigitalLink
Abstraction.Description: Download link for digital assets with access counter, expiry, and limit enforcement.
Abstraction.Purpose: Access-controlled digital download after order completion.

Abstraction.name: OrderPromotion
Abstraction.Description: Join entity linking promotions to orders with optional promotion code.
Abstraction.Purpose: Tracks which promotions were applied to an order.

Abstraction.name: PaymentRecord
Abstraction.Description: Immutable value object capturing payment snapshot for state calculation.
Abstraction.Purpose: Enables payment state computation without cross-module dependency on Payment entity.

Abstraction.name: OrderConstant
Abstraction.Description: Constraints, defaults, and query configuration constants for the Order entity.

Abstraction.name: OrderEnums
Abstraction.Description: OrderStatus (Draft, Placed, Canceled) and CheckoutState (Address, Delivery, Payment, Confirm, Complete) enums.

Mechanism.name: Checkout State Resolution
Mechanism.Description: ResolvedCheckoutSteps dynamically builds the step list by checking delivery, payment, and confirmation requirements at query time. This mirrors the Ruby checkout_flow DSL where steps are conditionally included based on order state.

Mechanism.name: Promotion Conflict Resolution
Mechanism.Description: PromotionAdjuster selects the single best competing promotion by ordering adjustments by amount ASC, created_at DESC, and created_at DESC. All non-winning adjustments are marked ineligible, ensuring only one promotion applies per order.

Mechanism.name: Store Credit Calculation
Mechanism.Description: TotalApplicableStoreCredit behaves differently depending on checkout state: after payment state, it returns the already-applied credit; before payment, it caps available credit at the order total (min(total, user_available)). This prevents over-crediting before checkout completes.

AntiPattern.name: Direct Payment Entity Access
AntiPattern.Avoid: Importing Payment or Shipment entities from Payment/Shipping modules into Order partials.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Use PaymentRecord value objects for state calculations; wire full entities only in Persistence layer.

AntiPattern.name: Mutable Checkout Steps
AntiPattern.Avoid: Adding/removing checkout steps by mutating arrays directly.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Use CheckoutRegistry for dynamic step registration with before/after constraints.

Benefits.Benefit: State machine ensures valid transitions only

Scenario.title: Checkout Requirement Evaluation
Scenario.Context: Before rendering the checkout UI, evaluate all requirements to determine which steps still need input.

No state machine coupling for UI validation
